messages:
vera: Quick idea from the postmortem — create a short-lived 'remediation escrow' for each action so items don't vanish after PM sign-off. Owner + backup + expiry + auto-reminders. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

mike: Good call. Require a verification step before closing escrow (smoke + metrics).

ada: Add recurrence tagging on incidents (e.g., recurrence:cache-timeout). If tag appears 3x in 30 days, escalate to a recurrence review ticket.

vera: Comms: bot posts new actions to #eng-oncall with one-line summary and repeats every 72h until closed. Keep updates terse.

ops-bot: [reminder] Action 2210000000-1 due in 24h  pinging backup @mike.

mike: I'll update the oncall handoff doc with an "IC observer" field so next IC sees outstanding escrows.

vera: Plan: pilot infra-only for 3 weeks. I'll build a board + schema by Fri. Demo next Wed for 15m. Please post brief updates in this thread during pilot. :rocket:
